interface.longDescription: ACI Risk Indicators connects to Aethon Credit Intelligence's quantitative risk analytics for digital-asset yield providers, through seven read-only tools. Without signing in, you can list the ACI modules and search the provider catalogue by name and module. When authenticated, the tools also return a provider's ACI Risk Indicator with its risk band, the criterion-level breakdown, side-by-side comparisons of two to five providers, a computed portfolio composite, and positions matched from their instrument identifiers (FIGI, ticker and venue, LEI, chain and contract address, or DTI) to the providers behind them. Intended users: analysts, investment committees and diligence teams at institutions allocating to digital-asset products. How results work: ACI Risk Indicators are model-derived quantitative analytics outputs for independent analysis. Each result contains only the fields the tools return, with its certification date and methodology version. Indicators are updated at each certification. A portfolio composite is a computed analytical output based on individual provider Risk Indicators. Identifier matching is exact; positions identified by ISIN or CUSIP are returned unresolved. ACI computes risk. You decide how to allocate capital. Methodology: https://aethoncredit.com/methodology
